problem: "Adding replicas inside one rack or zone: they share a failure domain, so availability does not rise" is too absolute. Replicas in one rack do protect against a single disk or server crash, so availability against those faults does rise; what they fail to protect against is a rack, zone or power failure.
fix: Adding replicas inside one rack or zone puts them in the same failure domain, so a rack, zone or power failure takes all of them at once. Replicas protect against disk and server faults but not against the shared failure domain, so cross-domain copies are still needed.

problem: "Cloud providers publish per-region error budgets" mixes two things. Providers publish SLAs and service health per region; an error budget is what a consuming team derives from its own SLO, and the team spends it on releases.
fix: Teams set SLOs per service and region, derive an error budget from them, and spend that budget on releases; the provider's published SLA is only the floor the team builds on.
